name: Coherence
description: Measures the logical flow and clarity of the conversation continuation. Responses should connect logically to the previous statements and maintain a consistent topic.

name: Relevance
description: Assesses how well the response pertains to the context and the preceding dialogue. The response should stay on topic and contribute meaningfully to the conversation.

name: Engagement Level
description: Evaluates the degree to which the response encourages further interaction or dialogue. Higher engagement indicates a greater likelihood of continuing the conversation.

name: Creativity
description: Measures the originality and inventiveness of the response. Creative responses should offer unique insights or perspectives that enhance the discussion.

name: Empathy
description: Assesses the ability of the response to acknowledge and relate to the feelings or experiences of the other participant. Empathetic responses create a connection and foster rapport.

name: Informational Value
description: Evaluates how much new, interesting, or useful information is provided in the response. Responses that include facts, insights, or anecdotes add value to the conversation.
scale: 1-5 (1: Low informational value, 5: High informational value)
